mapper.select:
SELECT COALESCE(s.representative_poi_id, s.legacy_poi_id, s.id) AS id, s.id AS spotId, s.legacy_place_group_id AS placeGroupId, s.name, s.address, s.cover_image AS image, s.description, s.rating, s.hotness, s.visit_count AS visits, s.longitude, s.latitude, s.spot_type AS spotType, COALESCE(pg.route_graph_status, 'none') AS routeGraphStatus, c.code AS category, c.name AS categoryName, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM foods f JOIN pois fp ON fp.id = f.poi_id WHERE f.status = 1 AND ( fp.spot_id = s.id OR fp.place_group_id = s.legacy_place_group_id ) ), 0) AS foodCount, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM travel_logs tl JOIN pois lp ON lp.id = tl.poi_id WHERE tl.status = 1 AND ( lp.spot_id = s.id OR lp.place_group_id = s.legacy_place_group_id ) ), 0) AS logCount, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM favorites f WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.target_type = 'poi' AND f.target_id = COALESCE(s.representative_poi_id, s.legacy_poi_id) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS favoriteMatched, CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_spot_actions usa WHERE usa.user_id = #{userId} AND usa.target_type = 'poi' AND usa.target_id = COALESCE(s.representative_poi_id, s.legacy_poi_id) AND usa.action_type = 'want' AND usa.active = 1 ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS wantMatched, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM browsing_history bh WHERE bh.user_id = #{userId} AND bh.target_type = 'poi' AND bh.target_id = COALESCE(s.representative_poi_id, s.legacy_poi_id) ), 0) AS browseCount, COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(up.weight) FROM user_preferences up JOIN spot_tag_relations str ON str.tag_id = up.tag_id WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} AND str.spot_id = s.id ), 0) AS preferenceScore, ( s.rating * 25 + s.hotness * 0.12 + s.visit_count * 0.05 + CASE WHEN s.legacy_place_group_id IN (3, 4, 5, 6) THEN 40 ELSE 0 END + COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) * 20 FROM browsing_history bh WHERE bh.user_id = #{userId} AND bh.target_type = 'poi' AND bh.target_id = COALESCE(s.representative_poi_id, s.legacy_poi_id) ), 0) + COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) * 60 FROM favorites f WHERE f.user_id = #{userId} AND f.target_type = 'poi' AND f.target_id = COALESCE(s.representative_poi_id, s.legacy_poi_id) ), 0) + COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(CASE usa.action_type WHEN 'want' THEN 70 WHEN 'visited' THEN 15 ELSE 0 END) FROM user_spot_actions usa WHERE usa.user_id = #{userId} AND usa.target_type = 'poi' AND usa.target_id = COALESCE(s.representative_poi_id, s.legacy_poi_id) AND usa.active = 1 ), 0) + COALESCE(( SELECT SUM(up.weight) * 25 FROM user_preferences up JOIN spot_tag_relations str ON str.tag_id = up.tag_id WHERE up.user_id = #{userId} AND str.spot_id = s.id ), 0) + CASE WHEN #{purpose} = 'photo' AND (c.code IN ('scenic', 'natural', 'waterfront', 'landmark') OR s.description LIKE '%拍照%' OR s.description LIKE '%打卡%') THEN 120 WHEN #{purpose} = 'study' AND (s.spot_type IN ('campus', 'university', 'museum') OR c.code IN ('museum', 'historic', 'memorial')) THEN 120 WHEN #{purpose} = 'food' THEN COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) * 35 FROM foods f JOIN pois fp ON fp.id = f.poi_id WHERE f.status = 1 AND ( fp.spot_id = s.id OR fp.place_group_id = s.legacy_place_group_id ) ), 0) WHEN #{purpose} = 'relax' AND (s.spot_type IN ('park', 'scenic') OR c.code IN ('scenic', 'natural', 'waterfront')) THEN 100 WHEN #{purpose} = 'route' AND COALESCE(pg.route_graph_status, 'none') IN ('draft', 'verified') THEN 140 ELSE 0 END ) AS planScore FROM spots s LEFT JOIN poi_categories c ON c.id = s.category_id LEFT JOIN place_groups pg ON pg.id = s.legacy_place_group_id WHERE s.status = 1 AND NOT ( s.spot_type = 'university' AND s.legacy_place_group_id IS NOT NULL AND s.representative_poi_id IS NULL AND s.legacy_poi_id IS NULL )
AND ( s.city LIKE CONCAT('%', #{city}, '%') OR s.province LIKE CONCAT('%', #{city}, '%') OR s.district LIKE CONCAT('%', #{city}, '%') OR s.address LIKE CONCAT('%', #{city}, '%') OR s.name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{city}, '%') )
AND (
c.code IN ('scenic', 'natural', 'waterfront', 'theme_park')
c.code IN ('historic', 'religious', 'memorial', 'museum', 'landmark')
c.code = 'museum'
s.spot_type IN ('campus', 'university') OR c.code = 'university'
s.spot_type IN ('business', 'campus') OR c.code IN ('commercial', 'university')
c.code IN ('scenic', 'landmark', 'waterfront', 'university')
c.code = #{preference} OR s.spot_type = #{preference}
)
AND COALESCE(pg.route_graph_status, 'none') IN ('draft', 'verified')
AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_spot_actions usa WHERE usa.user_id = #{userId} AND usa.target_type = 'poi' AND usa.target_id = COALESCE(s.representative_poi_id, s.legacy_poi_id) AND usa.action_type = 'visited' AND usa.active = 1 )
ORDER BY planScore DESC, s.rating DESC, s.hotness DESC, s.id ASC LIMIT #{limit}
